title: Is space exploration worth it?
instructionsHu: Vitatkozz a vizsgáztatóval az alábbi állításról. A kiosztott álláspontod: az állítás ELLEN érvelsz (szerinted megéri az űrkutatás) – ezt az álláspontot a vita során nem változtathatod meg. Fejtsd ki az érveidet, reagálj a vizsgáztató ellenérveire, és próbáld meggyőzni őt.

debate.statement: Space exploration is a waste of money that should be spent on solving problems on Earth
candidateIdeas: Many everyday technologies, such as GPS, weather forecasts and satellite communication, come from space research.
Satellites help us to monitor climate change, natural disasters and harvests.
Space budgets are small compared with what countries spend on many other things.
Space exploration inspires young people to study science and engineering.
In the long term, humanity may need resources or places to live beyond Earth.
examinerArguments: Millions of people still don't have clean water, enough food or basic health care.
Sending people to Mars is mainly about national pride and the egos of billionaires.
The money could be used directly to fight climate change.
Rockets and space debris pollute the atmosphere and the space around Earth.
Robots and telescopes can explore space much more cheaply than human missions.

followUpQuestions: How can we justify spending billions on rockets when people are starving?
Hungary sent its second astronaut to the International Space Station in 2025. Was that money well spent?
Wouldn't it be better to spend the money on fighting climate change?
